mapper.sql: signal_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, signal_type, content, source_type, source_ref, confidence, status, evidence_ref, detected_at, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opportunity_signal ( signal_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, signal_type, content, source_type, source_ref, confidence, status, evidence_ref, detected_at, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{signalId}, #{operatingCaseId}, #{journeyId}, #{signalType}, #{content}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{confidence}, #{status}, #{evidenceRef}, #{detectedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{confirmedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM opportunity_signal ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE opportunity_signal SET status = #{status}, confirmed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE confirmed_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE signal_id = #{signalId}
